prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: THREE new whole-body CEL ANIMATION continuation drawings for an existing game.
Image 1 is Rica's existing horizontal-spin atlas. Its bottom-row second figure is the rightward IMPACT pose to continue FROM. Image 2 is exact identity/costume/shovel reference.
Create ONE transparent RGBA sheet containing exactly ONE ROW of THREE complete full-body figures, chronological left to right. Fixed camera, same character scale, generous empty gutters so the whole shovel, boots and cape fit within each figure's area. Actual transparent alpha, no background or floor shadows.
PRIMARY REQUEST: FOLLOW THROUGH cleanly AFTER the shovel hits an enemy on screen RIGHT, like a full-power hammer throw or spinning backhand that cuts straight THROUGH the target. Do NOT stop at contact, pull the hands back, recoil or look bounced away. Arms, hips, shoulders and feet continue the SAME direction, carrying the heavy steel spade around the outside of her body. The original impact has both arms extended to screen right; these THREE pictures are the next stages AFTER it.
1 LEFT FIGURE: immediately AFTER rightward contact, rotating into REAR-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER. Keep arms driving the shovel farther beyond the target to SCREEN RIGHT at waist/chest level, no elbows recoiling. Hips already lead the next pivot, cape and one braid stream behind the motion. Rear right shoulder and most of cloak are visible. Not an impact hold or low guard.
2 MIDDLE FIGURE: next clear FULL BACK view. The SAME continuous horizontal rotation carries the shovel around AWAY from viewer, foreshortened shaft and pointed steel spade visible toward the UPPER RIGHT of the body around shoulder/waist level. Show the back of head and cloak, no face. Both hands keep their grip on the SAME intact rigid shaft. Strong pivot on grounded feet, braid and cape follow rotation. No overhead chop.
3 RIGHT FIGURE: deep REAR-LEFT / LEFT-FACING THREE-QUARTER FOLLOW-THROUGH. The same continued turn has swept the pointed steel spade all the way to SCREEN LEFT, hands left of her waist, elbows extended and then relaxing only after the blade is past the target. Torso and hips have continued around, knees bent, planted front foot and pivoting back foot; cape and the single braid flare to her right. This is the completed cut-through pose, NOT a ready guard or reversal. Face may look screen left with the follow-through.
Identity invariants: petite ADULT silver-haired elf woman with silver bob and exactly ONE continuous braid, long pointed ears, charcoal hood DOWN cape, dark teal long-sleeved dress, worn tan work apron, belt with keys/rope, brown fitted gloves, brown boots. Same adult face, costume and proportions as references. ONE rigid gravedigger shovel, consistent length: one long wooden shaft, one D-shaped grip at one end, one broad pointed steel spade at the other end. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands in physically plausible grips, no duplicate limbs or tools. The braid originates at the back of the head; when it flies outward do not also draw a braid hanging on the chest.
Polished detailed anime game illustration exactly matching the existing sprites. Entire full body and ENTIRE shovel visible. No neighboring sprites overlap. NO magic, energy, glow, sparks, motion trails, speed lines, text, labels, numbers, panels or borders: the game adds all effects. All THREE figures must be clearly DIFFERENT successive rear angles and show momentum continuing past impact, not the same pose repeated.
